title: Corner shop tycoon
author: PossiblyHelpfulAnt
selftext:
Hey all!

Something I've been working on for the past few weeks, little game called "Corner shop tycoon". Currently, I'm a software engineer, but I used to work in retail, and I always envisioned creating a smallish, cozy game where you could manage your own shop, with micromanagement elements. I started original work around 7-years ago in Unreal engine, but due to life constraints, had to abondon the project. Now, with help of Astra / Sol / DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, I was able to bring it to MVP fruitition in the browser. It's still barebones, but it has the elments I wanted it to have: Actual building of your of your shop, managing your own stock/product, prices, having employees with skills and progression, expanding your shop, events (appliances breaking, customer/market fluctation, team members leaving/getting sick). You can also start your own "producery" to produce goods, like a bakery. 

Employees have to actually stock shelves, tidy, take care of appliances, rest or produce. Shop doesnt run unless someone does something. Stock is brought by a truck each day, unloaded by a person. You have to plan your stock, different products require different stores (cold, freeze, dry).

It's still quite barebones, and needs alot of polishing, but if you are interested on trying out, give it a go and let me know what you think:

[https://games-gamma-mocha.vercel.app/](https://games-gamma-mocha.vercel.app/)
